# Sudbury Workforce

> Snow removal, house and apartment cleaning, lawn care, moving help, handyman services and general labour for homes and businesses across Greater Sudbury, Ontario.

- Call, text or WhatsApp: 705-562-9047
- Email: sudburyworkforce@gmail.com
- Free estimates; every job is quoted on its own.

## Services

- [Snow Removal](https://sudburyworkforce.github.io/sudburyworkforce/snow-removal-sudbury/): Driveway plowing, walkway shovelling and salting.
- [House & Apartment Cleaning](https://sudburyworkforce.github.io/sudburyworkforce/house-cleaning-sudbury/): House, apartment and move-out cleaning.
- [Lawn Care](https://sudburyworkforce.github.io/sudburyworkforce/lawn-care-sudbury/): Mowing, trimming and yard cleanups.
- [Moving Help](https://sudburyworkforce.github.io/sudburyworkforce/moving-help-sudbury/): Moving help, heavy lifting and deliveries.
- [Handyman](https://sudburyworkforce.github.io/sudburyworkforce/handyman-sudbury/): Assembly, mounting and small repairs.
- [General Labour](https://sudburyworkforce.github.io/sudburyworkforce/general-labour-sudbury/): Extra hands for sites and big projects.
- [Construction Cleaning](https://sudburyworkforce.github.io/sudburyworkforce/construction-cleaning-sudbury/): Post-renovation and new-build cleanup.

## Areas served

- Sudbury: Downtown, New Sudbury, South End, Minnow Lake
- Valley East & Capreol: Hanmer, Val Caron, Val Thérèse, Blezard Valley, Capreol
- West of Sudbury: Chelmsford, Azilda, Lively, Walden, Copper Cliff
- East of Sudbury: Garson, Falconbridge, Coniston
